segments.ja399:1.1: Te kathaṃ nu karissanti, vuddhā giridarīsayā;
segments.ja399:1.3: Ahaṃ baddhosmi pāsena, nilīyassa vasaṃ gato.
segments.ja399:2.1: Kiṃ gijjha paridevasi, kā nu te paridevanā;
segments.ja399:2.3: Na me suto vā diṭṭho vā, bhāsanto mānusiṃ dijo.
segments.ja399:3.3: Te kathaṃ nu karissanti, ahaṃ vasaṃ gato tava.
segments.ja399:4.1: Yaṃ nu gijjho yojanasataṃ, kuṇapāni avekkhati;
segments.ja399:4.3: Kasmā jālañca pāsañca, āsajjāpi na bujjhasi.
segments.ja399:5.3: Atha jālañca pāsañca, āsajjāpi na bujjhati.
segments.ja399:6.3: Mayā tvaṃ samanuññāto, sotthiṃ passāhi ñātake.
segments.ja399:7.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
